Folks —

I pulled the MAP PDF and sketched an internal delivery plan. High-level recommendations:
- EB attendees from Redwood: VP Sales (brief value narrative), Head of Solutions (demo + Q&A), Sally (CS lead) for post-sale ops overview. We can provide titles; Jordan's team asked for names closer to the meeting.
- Canary plan: 48-hour window for a production-like throughput test + 2-hour warm-up (KV warm) and a validation run. Gate thresholds: 95th-pct latency < 350ms and token-cost within 12% of quoted baseline.

I'll draft the eval checklist and share by EOD Nov 2. Ben, can you confirm compute and quantization profile we recommend for the canary (e.g., g4dn vs a100 equiv)? Also, Marissa/Karthik — any legal/EB pre-reads we should prepare?

Thanks,
